summary: The implementation provides a comprehensive construction project tracking system with Internet Identity authentication, role-based access control (Admin, Foreman, Buyer, Finance), master data management (Materials, Jobs, Vendors), and role-specific dashboards. The backend uses Motoko with single-actor architecture, and the frontend uses React with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. However, several critical requirements are missing: RAP/RAB creation system, RAP templates, material request workflow (REQ-5 to REQ-8), accounting system (REQ-9), progress tracking (REQ-10), S-Curve visualization (REQ-11), and material usage tracking (REQ-13).

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement RAP (Rencana Anggaran Pelaksanaan) and RAB (Rencana Anggaran Biaya) creation system with unlimited nested sub-job structure where each level has its own volume, unit, and separate cost
missing_requirements.reason: No RAP/RAB creation system is visible in the diff. Jobs exist with nested structure (parentId field), but there is no dedicated RAP/RAB entity or RAP builder interface beyond the route stub.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create master RAP template system that allows users to save reusable RAP structures and apply existing templates to new projects
missing_requirements.reason: RAPTemplate type exists in backend (backend/main.mo) and routes are defined, but no evidence of CRUD operations, template saving/loading, or UI implementation for managing templates.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement material/fund request workflow where Foreman selects a main job (automatically including all sub-jobs and materials) to create a request
missing_requirements.reason: MaterialRequest type exists but no workflow logic for selecting jobs with automatic sub-job inclusion. No evidence of request creation linking jobs to materials or capturing job hierarchies.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement Buyer review and approval stage where Buyer can view requests from Foreman, edit quantities and prices, and approve partially with remaining amounts tracked for future requests
missing_requirements.reason: MaterialRequest has approvedByBuyer and buyerPrice fields, but no partial approval logic, remaining amount tracking, or buyer editing capabilities are evident in the backend implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement Finance review and approval stage where Finance receives data from Buyer, can edit and approve partially, with final approval completing the workflow
missing_requirements.reason: MaterialRequest has approvedByFinance and financePrice fields, but no partial approval workflow, remaining amount tracking, or finance editing/approval functions visible in backend.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement realization report system where Buyer inputs actual prices from invoices/receipts after Finance approval is complete
missing_requirements.reason: RealizationReport type exists but no linkage to MaterialRequest or workflow logic ensuring realization only occurs after Finance approval. No implementation of realization form or data linking.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement comprehensive accounting system with automatic journal entries, general ledger, balance sheet, profit and loss statement, cash flow report, and budget vs actual comparison per job
missing_requirements.reason: No accounting entities (journal entries, ledger accounts, financial statements) or automatic journal generation logic exist in the backend. AccountingDashboardPage route exists but no underlying accounting implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement progress tracking system where progress dates are recorded for main jobs to generate S-Curve data
missing_requirements.reason: ProgressRecord type exists but no implementation of recording progress dates for main jobs or linking progress to jobs. No progress input logic or S-Curve data generation visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement S-Curve visualization showing timeline progress versus planned schedule based on main jobs with interactive chart
missing_requirements.reason: SCurvePage route exists but no charting library integration, S-Curve calculation logic, or visualization component is implemented. No evidence of planned vs actual progress curves.

missing_requirements.requirement: Implement material usage tracking where Buyer can view total materials used against requests when additional requests are submitted
missing_requirements.reason: MaterialUsagePage route exists but no cumulative material usage tracking logic, material consumption aggregation, or usage report functionality is implemented in backend or frontend.
